d:
Gold Rush takes the competition in Klondike to another level as rival mining crews push themselves to reach the massive target of 3,000 ounces of gold. With rivalries intensifying and every decision carrying a cost, the miners face tough challenges as they race against time to hit their goals. Who will come out ahead, and who will fall behind in the fight for gold?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 6, Episodes 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 15 and 19, on Discovery Channel India.
